title: 手写 DPO Loss：如何从 token logits 得到 sequence log-prob？
quick: >-
  先对 response token gather log-softmax，按 response mask 求 sequence logp；分别算
  policy chosen/rejected 与 reference chosen/rejected
  margin，logit=β[(πc−πr)−(refc−refr)]，loss=−logsigmoid(logit)。

<div class="quick"><div class="mini-title">30 秒回答</div><p>先对 response token gather log-softmax，按 response mask 求 sequence logp；分别算 policy chosen/rejected 与 reference chosen/rejected margin，logit=β[(πc−πr)−(refc−refr)]，loss=−logsigmoid(logit)。</p></div>
          <div class="full-answer"><div class="mini-title">完整答案</div><pre><code data-lang="python">import torch.nn.functional as F

def sequence_logp(logits, labels, response_mask):
    # logits [B,T,V] predicts labels at same aligned positions for simplicity
    log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits.float(), dim=-1)
    tok = log_probs.gather(-1, labels.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
    return (tok * response_mask).sum(-1)

def dpo_loss(pi_c, pi_r, ref_c, ref_r, beta=0.1):
    # inputs are sequence log-probs
    logits = beta * ((pi_c - pi_r) - (ref_c - ref_r))
    return -F.logsigmoid(logits).mean()</code></pre><span class="math display"><mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" display="true"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.791ex;" assistant response token，prompt 不计 sequence preference likelihood。Variable length 还要明确是 sum logp 还是 average logp；DPO 经典形式用 sequence log-prob sum。</p></div>
          <div class="followups"><div class="mini-title">常见追问与答案</div><details class="followup"><summary>为什么 reference log-prob 可以预计算？</summary><div class="follow-answer"><p>如果 reference 冻结且数据固定，可以离线缓存 chosen/rejected logp，节省训练时一次 reference forward；但数据/模板/tokenization 改动后必须重新计算。</p></div></details><details class="followup"><summary>若 padding token 也被计入 logp 会怎样？</summary><div class="follow-answer"><p>不同长度样本会获得错误的额外 likelihood，形成严重 length confound；必须用 response/padding mask。</p></div></details></div>
